title: 第十二章
slug: 国民校草是女生全本免费-国民校草是女生最新章节列表
content_zh:
她浅笑的掰了一下手腕，把竖起来的英语书放下之后，就又回归到了那个最过普通不过的学渣高中生。
没有人知道就在刚刚，她攻掉了一个职业黑客！
第三间课课间，博九还在想着一会中午休息的时候要去吃什么。
校广播就在头顶响了起来，声音听上去非常的振奋：“同学们，为了网罗人才，你们的学长秦漠，将会代表秦氏集团，来校视察……”
那人还没说完，学生们就啊啊啊的尖叫了起来！
秦漠，真正的天之骄子，根正红苗的出身，权倾三省，称霸电竞。
他平时的行踪都是个谜，就算是在学校，也从不露面。
不是在战队，就是在公司，秦少永远都是高不可攀的存在。
要想见他的正面，就要看大型的游戏直播和近千万的粉丝争存在感。
现在他竟然要来校视察了？！
幸福太突然，整个一中的学生们，全部都沸腾了！
唯有博九，坐在椅子上伸了个懒腰，心道：看来下午不用上课了，又能再打两把游戏，赚上它五百元。
为了迎接秦漠的到来，林荫路被打扫十分的干净，校领导也都穿上了西装。
半个小时后，三四辆顶级军用悍马，驶入了校门，漆黑的车身，流线的设计，低调中是难掩的奢华。
“啊！”又是一阵激动的尖叫声席卷了整个校园，全部的师生们都亢奋的朝着同一个方向蜂拥而去。
身着黑色上衣的保镖们形成了一道警戒线，警戒线的这边的人，全部都点起了脚尖，努力的想要看到男神的尊容。
唯有博九，不慌不忙的在集合队伍中站着。
她原本以为校领导出来迎接人，她还能在教室里赚赚外快，没有想到还要全校师生都集合。
果然就像晓东说的，这位秦少的家世，确实高出了博家好几个级别。
毕竟人可是军区大院里出来的，爷爷还是位开国元勋。

实际上在江市一中向来不缺有钱人。
之前喜欢欺负人的霍思雨就是这其中的一位。
在她的眼里，博九永远都是个上不了台面的土包子。
所以她才会因为博九打了她的事，更加的怀恨在心。
霍思雨是不知道这家伙怎么会突然之间变得不好对付了，心虚是家里请人教了他两招。
不过今天，那些都不再重要。
她非要让他当众出个大丑！
霍思雨眸光一转，就落在了前方的警戒线上，再看看站在她前面低头玩着手机的博九，悄悄往后一退，趁着谁都没有注意的时候。
啪的一下！
将博九狠狠的推了出去！
博九还在想下午买零件的事，一个不设防，身子往前一弯，硬生生的撞进了一个人的怀里……

content_en:
She smiled slightly and cracked her wrist, put down the English book she had raised, and then returned to the most ordinary high school student she was.
No one knew that just now, she had defeated a professional hacker!
During the third class break, Bo Jiu was still thinking about what to eat during lunch break.
The school radio rang above the head, and the voice sounded very exciting: "Students, in order to recruit talents, your senior Qin Mo will come to the school to inspect on behalf of the Qin Group..."
Before the man finished speaking, the students started screaming!
Qin Mo, the true pride of heaven, was born in Hongmiao. He had power over three provinces and dominated e-sports.
His usual whereabouts are a mystery, and he never shows up even at school.
Either in the team or in the company, Master Qin will always be unattainable.
If you want to see his face, you have to watch large-scale game live broadcasts and nearly ten million fans competing for his presence.
Now he actually wants to come to the school to inspect? !
The happiness was so sudden that all the students in No. 1 Middle School were excited!
Only Bo Jiu sat on the chair and stretched out, thinking: It seems that there is no need for classes in the afternoon, and he can play two more games and earn five hundred yuan.
In order to welcome Qin Mo's arrival, the tree-lined road was cleaned very clean, and the school leaders also put on suits.
Half an hour later, three or four top-grade military Hummers drove into the school gate. Their dark bodies and streamlined designs showed unmistakable luxury in a low-key manner.
"Ah!" Another burst of excited screams swept through the entire campus, and all the teachers and students swarmed excitedly in the same direction.
The bodyguards in black shirts formed a cordon. The people on this side of the cordon all pointed their toes, trying hard to see the handsome face of the male god.
Only Bo Jiu stood calmly in the gathering team.
She originally thought that the school leaders would come out to greet people and she could make extra money in the classroom, but she didn't expect that all the teachers and students in the school would have to gather.
Sure enough, as Xiaodong said, this Young Master Qin's family background is indeed several levels higher than that of the Bo family.
After all, he came from the military compound, and his grandfather was one of the founding fathers of the country.
In fact, there has always been no shortage of rich people in Jiangshi No. 1 Middle School.
Huo Siyu, who used to like bullying others, is one of them.
In her eyes, Bojiu will always be a country bumpkin who can't get on the stage.
That's why she felt even more resentful because Bo Jiu beat her.
Huo Siyu didn't know how this guy suddenly became difficult to deal with. He felt guilty because his family asked someone to teach him two tricks.
But today, those are no longer important.
She insisted on making him look embarrassed in public!
Huo Siyu's eyes turned and landed on the warning line in front. Then she looked at Bo Jiu who was standing in front of her with his head down and playing with his mobile phone. He quietly stepped back while no one was paying attention.
Snap!
Pushed Bo Jiu out hard!
Bo Jiu was still thinking about buying parts in the afternoon. Unprepared, he bent forward and bumped into someone's arms...
